group:paper-mock-zhejiang-jiyang-2024-11.overview: 文章探讨低因咖啡能否带来与普通咖啡相同的健康益处，比较两者的差别，分析咖啡因的利与弊，并指出喝咖啡的效果还取决于吸烟、加糖等相伴的习惯和喝法。
group:paper-mock-zhejiang-jiyang-2024-11.fullTranslationZh:
喝咖啡被认为与降低患 II 型糖尿病、痴呆等神经系统疾病乃至死亡的风险有关。但随着越来越多的人改喝低因咖啡，他们还能获得同样的这些好处吗？
低因咖啡与普通咖啡相比如何
好消息是，咖啡的许多健康益处在脱咖啡因咖啡中依然存在。人们认为，这是因为咖啡豆中含有抗氧化剂，其中许多在咖啡因被去除后仍然保留。尽管有所减少，抗氧化剂的总体含量仍然很高。这能为喝低因咖啡的人带来实实在在的好处。
咖啡因的利与弊
研究人员发现，所有喝咖啡的人（包括喝低因咖啡的人）患心血管疾病和死亡的风险都有所降低。此外，咖啡因还有助于缓解偏头痛。不过，咖啡因的影响可能各不相同。短期内，摄入过多咖啡因会导致神经紧张、睡眠紊乱、头痛或心跳过快。从长期看，摄入过多咖啡因会使人在试图戒掉时出现头痛等戒断症状。
具体情况很重要
咖啡的健康益处之所以争论了这么久，原因之一是喝咖啡往往与其他习惯相伴。研究人员发现，喝咖啡与较高的吸烟率有关，而这些人面临的肺癌等健康风险是吸烟而非咖啡造成的。另一项研究发现，经常喝咖啡与随着时间推移体重增加较少有关。但前提是饮用者喝的是黑咖啡或只加奶油、不加糖的咖啡。无论喝的是普通咖啡还是低因咖啡，这一点都成立。“喝不加糖的咖啡似乎是正确的选择。”鲍尔说。

completedSourceTexts.text: Drinking coffee has been linked to a reduced risk of developing type II diabetes, neurological conditions such as dementia, and even death. But as people increasingly turn to decaf, are they still getting those same benefits?

The good news is that many of coffee’s health benefits are still found in decaffeinated(脱咖啡因) coffee. The reason for this is thought to be due to the levels of antioxidants(抗氧化剂) in coffee beans, many of which remain even after the caffeine has been removed. Reduced though, the overall levels of antioxidants are still high. That can translate to real benefits for decaf drinkers.

Researchers found a reduced risk of cardiovascular disease and death in all coffee drinkers, which included people who drank decaf. Also, caffeine can help alleviate migraines (偏头痛) The effects of caffeine can vary, however. In the short-term, consuming too much caffeine can cause jitteriness, sleep disruptions, headaches, or a racing heart. Long-term, consuming too much caffeine can lead to withdrawal symptoms, such as headaches, if a person tries to stop.

One of the reasons that the health benefits of coffee have been debated for so long is due to the fact that its consumption can often go hand in hand with other habits. Researchers found coffee drinking was associated with a higher rate of smoking cigarettes – and that the health risks they faced such as lung cancer were due to smoking rather than coffee. Another study found, regular coffee consumption is associated with a reduced amount of weight gain over time. But only if drinkers had their coffee black or with cream, but no sugar. This held true whether people were drinking regular or decaf coffee. “Having unsweetened coffee seems to be the way to go,” Ball says.
